title: How Long a Snowsports School Participant Is on the Hill and What the Lift Access Is Counted On
content:
How long the participant is actually on the hill decides which count the price of the lift access is taken on for a Snowsports School booking.

**Where a block has been loaded against the booking and the product's session runs for four hours or more**, the price is taken in full for each session the block loaded.

**Where a block has been loaded against the booking and the product's session runs for fewer than four hours**, the price is taken at the half day share of 50 percent for each session the block loaded, a short session needing only half a lift day.

**Where no block has been loaded against the booking**, the price is taken in full for each session the booking holds.

## The session lengths the bands turn on

| Product | Session length (hours) | Band a loaded block falls in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 3.00 | fewer than four hours |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 5.00 | four hours or more |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 5.00 | four hours or more |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 2.00 | fewer than four hours |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 3.00 | fewer than four hours |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 6.00 | four hours or more |
| Elite Performance Camp | 6.00 | four hours or more |

A session of exactly four hours would fall in the first band, four hours being four hours or more.

## Worked illustrations

Take a product whose lift ticket add-on price is 119.00 USD.

- A booking of the Six-Week Development Programme, whose session runs 2.00 hours, on which a block of 6 sessions has been loaded: the price is taken at 50 percent for each of the 6 sessions the block loaded, which is 59.50 USD a session and 357.00 USD in all.
- A booking of the Elite Performance Camp, whose session runs 6.00 hours, on which a block of 5 sessions has been loaded: the price is taken in full for each of the 5 sessions the block loaded.
- A booking on which no block has been loaded: the price is taken in full for each session the booking itself holds, whatever the product's session length.
